description: Validates repair costs, hull restoration, and shipyard requirement constraints

tests.name: Rig: Move Captain and active ship to isolated port sector

data.sql: WITH moved_ship AS (UPDATE ships SET sector_id = 9999 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'captain_crunch') RETURNING ship_id) UPDATE players SET sector_id = 9999 WHERE name = 'captain_crunch' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moved_ship);

tests.name: Rig: Mark isolated test port as Stardock

data.sql: UPDATE ports SET sector_id = 9999, type = 9, porttype_id = (SELECT porttype_id FROM porttypes WHERE code = 'STARDOCK') WHERE port_id = 9;
UPDATE ships SET hull = 73 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'captain_crunch');

tests.name: Verify repaired hull through ship.status repository read
A fully repaired ship is not charged again
